verdict.rationale: Algolia does have configurable automations: data-ingestion schedules, retries and transformations kept by Algolia, plus rules and Agent Studio workflows. So asking whether they can be versioned, reviewed and rolled back is a fair question for this product. The evidence shows a CLI for managing settings, rules and synonyms in scripts and CI, but nothing documents version history, change review, or rollback for those automations. Turning the CLI into a config-as-code workflow is only an inference, not something the evidence shows.
